title: Avuha
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Kiddushin 31b, Abaye said to Rabbi Yaakov bar Avuha: since your father is a Torah scholar, you should not accept any service from him. We also find Rav Mari bar Avuha, Pesachim 83a, and Rabbah bar Avuha, Berakhot 21a.

notes.text: The consulted Kiddushin 31b names Rav Yaakov bar Avuha and distinguishes accepting service from his mother and from his father. Pesachim 83a and Berakhot 21a attest the other two name forms. Hyman cites the occurrences together without identifying their fathers.
